body:
Kunj explicitly asked me to notify the other agents. Rollout coordination: he confirmed another agent is deploying, so I have made NO cluster changes and am leaving that deployment in its owner's hands.

WEB / active Kunj deployer: PR35 is merged at 0cb48fd; fresh verification passed 171 Vitest +37 Node tests and an explicitly live-mode TypeScript/production build on Node22. At my Radar inspection, web generation13 was rolling source71741b3 (PR32 guided-demo branch), which does NOT include the attendee survey/site/trends/trail implementation. Public #/join still showed the older presence-only form. Integrate PR35/current main into the chosen guided-demo source before the next web pin. Preserve YOLO, server Secret references, collector and host routing; do not overwrite one another's rollout. Working Node on this Mac is /usr/local/bin/node (Homebrew Node25 fails loading libsimdjson.29.dylib).

LUKE / AHMED / ANURUP: correction to my earlier timeout-blocker summary: Luke has now pushed e3df36f on luke/site-builder. Its handoff records removing refresh waits from ledger creates and OCC updates, 25 passing worker tests and real backstage-demo publication run_rfyhzyfolvbo with commit10c3916. Luke also records agent-github created. Ahmed's latest e086b3c records API831aece ready and agent still paused at0 awaiting the fix. Coordinate consumption of the tested worker SHA and verify the Secret's presence/key names without printing values; then rehearse hosted site generation before declaring success. Search-based trail/count views may lag normal refresh.

Acceptance: real QR-source survey -> queued/building/ready -> inert generated page -> session tap -> trends + matching trail run; verify a real commit link versus explicitly labeled dry-run. Check projector QR/site count and existing video detection. Keep template/model and simulated/real provenance explicit. A real phone pass remains outstanding. Latest main reviewed9d4f478 includes merged PR37; no credentials included here.

Kunj explicitly asked me to fix and merge PR32. I am reconciling App.tsx with latest main, fixing pausable simulation timers and repeat rehearsal/reset behavior, with regression tests. I noticed concurrent recording commit bf7a84a and will preserve it through a normal merge, without force push. Please avoid parallel edits to the PR32 head while this correction is in progress. Cluster rollout stays with its active owner; this action is code/review/merge only.

PR32 is now MERGED as e3a8f08de7c4c020fbb601608321201cb8fad19c. User explicitly requested fixing and merging it. Normal merges preserved bf7a84a Kokoro/1440p recording work, latest pivot routes, header/settings and backend/QA/platform updates; no force push or cluster changes by this agent.

Both Gitar findings are fixed and closed: Pause freezes mock background/dispatch/evidence/injection timers with remaining-delay resume; repeated rehearsals require fresh approval/acceptance and Reset scenario clears the driver. Tour-mode pivot/presence/projector routes stay in private mocks, including on live builds.

Final validation:191 frontend +37 Node tests, explicit live-mode TypeScript/build, final production Docker image and lane check pass. Headb99166e checks: scaffold27s, ownership10s, Gitar32s; GitHub CLEAN before merge. Browser production preview keeps the mic proposed while paused. Previous recording was preserved, not regenerated after corrections.

ACTIVE DEPLOYER: use current merged main/e3a8f08 or a later descendant containing these fixes for the next coordinated web pin. This contains the attendee implementation and corrected guided tour together. Preserve vision, existing server Secret references, collector, gateway and single-writer API. I have left cluster rollout ownership with you. Fresh hosted full-flow verification is separate from this merge.
